localizedValues.name: HB1
localizedValues.description: This first come first served site is designated as a walk-in, bicycle-in site and is only for campers who arrive at the park on foot or bicycle. Campers who arrive at the park with a motorized vehicle are not allowed to occupy the site.

localizedValues.name: S1
localizedValues.description:
Covered picnic shelter located in day use area. Amplified music, karaoke machines, or dispensing alcoholic beverages from containers larger than two gallons is prohibited in state parks. If you decorate, all staples, tape, rope, banners, balloons need to be removed.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: S2
localizedValues.description:
Fireplace and BBQ on site. Amplified music, karaoke machines, or dispensing alcoholic beverages from containers larger than two gallons is prohibited in state parks. If you decorate, all staples, tape, rope, banners, balloons need to be removed.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description: The group camp has a covered picnic shelter with a wood stove and countertops. There is a large campfire ring with benches. There are picnic tables and BBQs as well as a vault toilet for the group camp. Trailers are allowed but there are no utility pedestals available in the group camp. It is a large open space but some of the turns to access the area are tight, trailers over 35’ are not recommended.

localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description:
Cabin C1 is furnished with a heater, air conditioner, full-size futon, twin-size bunk bed that sleeps two, table with four chairs, and small end table. Outside there is a picnic table, fire pit with grate, and a small patio table with two folding chairs. Bathrooms and showers are nearby. No pets, no cooking, no smoking inside the cabin. Bring your own bedding.
The parking pad has a utility hookup for RV or trailer available for $35 per night at the park.
